step_definition: One step is one full market tick for one lane: the engine applies that lane's Decision at the current daily bar, clears fills under the cost model, marks the book and advances the cursor by one bar. A batched call over B lanes counts B steps. This unit is not a token, not a tool call and not an agent turn.

seeding.lane_seed: lane index i, scenario seed = exec seed = i

measurement.warmup: 2 discarded repetitions per measured cell, executed immediately before the timed repetitions of that cell, on the same constructed objects
measurement.timed_unit: steps per second within one repetition; repetitions are the independent observations
measurement.uncertainty: median, mean, sample standard deviation over repetitions, and a 95 percent normal-approximation interval on the mean; n is reported so the interval can be re-derived

environment_record_required: cpu model, physical cores, logical processors, base clock
rustc and cargo version, cargo profile
C compiler used for the Python extension
python version, pyo3 version, package versions
rayon thread allocation for each measured cell
